text:
kevin: quick flag 1: docs transcribe example under /v1/speech/transcribe is inconsistent with runtime. example uses mp3 and shows "segments" array with startMs/endMs but server returns "chunks" with seconds as floats.

anya: oof good catch. where did you see this?

kevin: on the live page + openapi file. openapi.media.type says application/octet-stream but the code sample uses audio/mpeg. i tested and endpoint accepts audio/wav best; mp3 works but leads to broken timestamps in the example.

rahul: can you paste minimal failing curl?

kevin: sure:

```bash
curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.com/v1/speech/transcribe" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -F "file=@meeting.mp3;type=audio/mpeg" \
  -F "model=whisper-1" \
  -F "language=en"
```

kevin: response body in prod is: {"chunks":[{"start":0.0,"end":3.27,"text":"hey team"}],"language":"en"}

phil: so mismatch is: docs show segments with ms ints, actual returns chunk times in seconds floats, and the top-level field name is chunks not segments. good catch.

anya: i'll open a PR to update examples + openapi to prefer audio/wav and show the chunks shape. also add a note: older mp3 examples may have ms ints from legacy service; add migration line.

rahul: SDK snippets too: node example used fs.readFileSync and sent as JSON base64 blob. that's incorrect for our multipart-only route. need to use form-data in both python/node samples.

kevin: can add example for streaming transcription (websocket) as a callout, but keep main example multipart form upload.

docs-ci: lint error: docs/speech.md line 88: example code fence missing language.

anya: thanks bot. PR: https://git.redwood.dev/redwood/docs/pull/529 - changes: openapi requestBody.content -> audio/wav, curl sample shows wav, example response updated to chunks with seconds, python/node snippets use form-data helpers, migration note added under "Changes".

phil: i'll review the node snippet. ensure we call out that model param key is still "model" (not model_id) to avoid confusion. also include a quick test command using sox to convert mp3->wav: `sox input.mp3 -r 16000 output.wav` in a one-liner.

rahul: nit: make the response example include language detection field in case the caller didn't set language param. we return "language": "en" optionally.

anya: pushed fixes, included sox note, added language field in example, and fixed code fence languages. CI tests for docs build locally.

kevin: PTAL when you have 2 mins. i added a short migration blurb: "If you relied on ms timestamps or the old segments array, switch to the `chunks` array and note timestamps are seconds as floats."

phil: LGTM. left one tiny wording nit on the migration blurb.

anya: fixed wording nit and squashed. CI passed. merging in 2. :shipit:

docs-ci: docs-preview deployed to https://docs-preview.redwood.dev/speech/transcribe (expires in 2h). screenshot diff shows updated examples.

kevin: thanks all. can we add a note to the release notes for the SDK teams so they can check their generated examples? rahul can you ping the sdk-owners channel after merge?

rahul: yup i will ping sdk-owners and include the PR link.

kevin: closing thread.
